scope: Final semantic review of C627 model, Rule, and CA-E-669 Draft candidates and retirement coverage only. This is not a parser, solver, runtime, projection, or full evaluator conformance claim.

checks.name: approved_step_alternatives
checks.conclusion: The three approved IF clauses jointly require one Action or Workflow target, or one or more Substeps; the union target count is exactly one.

checks.name: substep_leaf_target
checks.evidence: CA-R-2466@3-draft scopes Substep and requires Substep//{:1}((RUNS)) Action//.
checks.conclusion: A Substep remains Action-only with exactly one target.

checks.name: relation_scoping_and_inverse
evidence: RUNS declares Step-to-Action-or-Workflow and Substep-to-Action signatures under its own Relation subject.
IS_RUN_BY declares the corresponding derived inverse signatures, including Workflow-to-Step.
RUNS declares HAS_INVERSE IS_RUN_BY; IS_RUN_BY is explicitly derived and not a separately authored fact.
checks.conclusion: The endpoint signatures are scoped by their owning Declaration and do not authorize duplicate authored inverse facts.

checks.name: binding_and_workflow_separation
evidence: Bind Step parameters assigns Action-or-Workflow bindings to the Step.
It admits exactly the three approved sources: previous Step output, enclosing Workflow Run input, and a fixed Step value.
Keep Workflow graphs separate from Step bindings constrains the Workflow graph scheme only; it does not impose a universal Workflow input contract.
checks.conclusion: Both callees share the approved binding sources without collapsing reusable callee contracts into the caller or Workflow graph.

checks.name: evaluation_draft_alignment
checks.evidence: CA-E-669@3-draft checks the same exclusive Step modes, the three named Action-or-Workflow parameter sources, the Substep Action-only constraint, and derived non-duplicated inverse views.
checks.conclusion: The evaluation Draft is aligned with the reviewed model and Rule candidates, while expressly separating Draft consistency from source adoption, parser conformance, graph reconstruction, and runtime admission.

checks.name: retirement_meaning_coverage
evidence: C627 manifest maps CA-R-1569 and CA-R-1992 generic alternative/cardinality meaning to CA-R-2465 and CA-R-2466, containment to CA-R-2478 and CA-R-2470, and bindings to the fresh Rule.
The two earlier Linear/Conditional and routing statements are preserved in deferred-classification-and-routing-notes.md rather than silently adopted.
The manifest correctly requires acceptance of the named successors before either legacy Rule is retired.
checks.conclusion: No reviewed meaning is lost in the candidate packet; retirement remains conditional on adoption, not completed by this review.

not_checked: Runtime, parser, solver, test, fixture, or evaluator behavior
Actual Workflow, Step, Substep, or Action instance migration
